narrative:
FY2025 GP of NOK 1,562M grows to NOK 1,690M in the Q3 Forecast (+8.2%) — NOK 30M short of the NOK 1,720M ambition. Conversational (+NOK 66M) and verification & platform (+NOK 62M) carry the growth; wholesale gives back NOK 12M.

Three levers add about NOK 29.5M at midpoint, closing 98% of the gap.

signals.title: FY2026 GP forecast NOK 30M short of the double-digit ambition
signals.source: SDP Q3 Forecast (9+3) vs FY2026 Budget (MyLINK CORE ambition)
signals.excerpt: Gross profit lands at NOK 1,690M (+8.2% on FY2025), NOK 30M (1.7%) below the NOK 1,720M ambition. Growth is broad across the five European markets; the gap is a mix issue, not a market issue.

signals.title: Adjusted EBITDA NOK 680M — 40.2% of GP, gate passed
signals.source: SDP GP & EBITDA Consolidation — 21 markets, 6 planning markets
signals.excerpt: Opex of NOK 1,010M (personnel NOK 640M, platform & cloud NOK 185M). The finance gate passes: within 5% of ambition and above the 38% EBITDA floor. Four legacy SMSC platforms migrate onto MyLINK CORE.
